# Core Rule 1 - Don't be a dick.
Everyone is playing this server to have a good time. Dont intentionally ruin that.
## Examples
### [bold] Permitted [/bold]
- Cause issues for someone who has wronged you. - Persue other goals after completing your job's needs. - Act antagonistic as an antagonist.
### [bold] Not Permitted [/bold]
- Needlessly sabotage the station as crew. - Abandon your job leading to station sabotage. For example not setting up power as an engi or make meds as a chemist. - Making problems for a character because you dont like the player. - Spamming any channel is not allowed unless granted explicit permission from an admin as part of a gimmick.
